# Startseite

## Row {height=20% .tabset}

### Sommerspiele

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Teilnehmer*innen alltime (Sommer)"
list(
  icon = "people-fill",
  color = "#E69F00",
  value = scales::comma(stats_summer$n_total)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
list(
  title = paste0("Frauen ", stats_summer$latest_year),
  icon = "gender-female",
  color = "#E69F00",
  value = paste0(
    scales::comma(stats_summer$n_women_current), " (",
    scales::percent(stats_summer$share_women_current, accuracy = 0.1), ")"
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
list(
  title = paste0("Frauen ", stats_summer$first_year_women, " (erstes Jahr)"),
  icon = "calendar-event",
  color = "#E69F00",
  value = paste0(
    scales::comma(stats_summer$n_women_first), " (",
    scales::percent(stats_summer$share_women_first, accuracy = 0.1), ")"
  )
)
```

## Row {height=80%}

```{r}
#| include: false
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(knitr)
library(markdown)
```

### Column
```{r}
#| title: "Frauenanteil bei Olympischen Spielen über Zeit"
p <- ggplot(gender_by_year_female, aes(x = Year, y = share, color = Season)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, NA)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Summer" = "#E69F00", "Winter" = "#0072B2")) +
  labs(
    x = "Jahr",
    y = "Anteil weiblicher Athlet:innen",
    color = "Saison"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

ggplotly(p)
```
